# FDG7037

> DO NOT throw `System.Exception` or `System.SystemException`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.3.1 Exception and SystemException.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA2201
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

CA2201 reports creating System.Exception or System.SystemException, thrown or not. Its other reports belong to FDG7018, FDG7040 and FDG7045 to FDG7049. CA2201 has no code fix.
